stories.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
stories.take: Congress opens a second Nvidia investigation into China sales and the company's dealings with Trump — the Huang fallout is now a formal political fight.

stories.title: Jensen Huang and the end of the ‘lol nothing matters’ era of American politics
stories.take: Platformer's read: the real Nvidia scandal is Silicon Valley's founder cult — one man's conduct became a national-security problem because no one could check him.

stories.title: ‘Bring Back THE Boss’: Nvidia Employees Petition for Jensen Huang’s Return
stories.take: Inside Nvidia, staff are petitioning to bring Huang back — 1,600+ comments, mostly in support, even after the resignation.

stories.title: Microsoft begins restoring services as global outage affects Outlook and Teams
stories.take: Microsoft is restoring Outlook and Teams after a global outage that drew nearly 130,000 user reports — the workday outage is winding down, not escalating.

stories.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
stories.take: Google's AI Mode, now on Gemini 4 Hydrogen, promises better answers to complex questions with richer visuals and more relevant links.

stories.title: Google pushes privacy angle as Gemini-powered smartglasses debut starting at $395
stories.take: Google's Gemini smartglasses with Samsung, Warby Parker and Gentle Monster start at $395 — and Google is leading with privacy to separate them from Meta's.

stories.title: FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace
stories.take: The FAA is expanding AI congestion advice across all US airspace; airlines praise it, but the controllers' union wasn't involved.

stories.title: Yahoo becomes first licensee of ‘Spotify-like’ collective AI content licensing model
stories.take: Yahoo is the first licensee of a collective, Spotify-like AI licensing model — publishers may finally have a standard way to get paid for AI search use.

stories.title: Sociable: Meta’s AI ads included unapproved discounts
stories.take: Meta's AI ad tools reportedly posted discount offers customers never approved, even with promotions off — a trust problem for automated ads.

stories.title: How Unilever’s social-first marketing is evolving amid reorganization
stories.take: Unilever is reorganizing its social-first marketing around 'global strategy, local execution' — the model other big brands keep copying.

stories.title: Oreo refreshes holiday creative with spin on Santa’s milk and cookies
stories.take: Oreo's first new holiday work in five years: Santa takes revenge on a dad who sneaks his cookies.

stories.title: Why brands like Anthropologie are commissioning creator-created shows instead of posts
stories.take: Brands like Anthropologie are commissioning whole creator-made shows instead of one-off posts — creators are becoming networks, not placements.

stories.title: Week of Nov 2 Cable News Ratings: Midterm Elections Bring in Viewers
stories.take: Midterms lifted cable news: Fox News led total viewers for the week of Nov. 2, while CNN led the 25-54 demo.

stories.title: Cade authors NBA's first 50-point, 10-assist, 0-turnover game in 2OT thriller
stories.take: Cade Cunningham made history: 52 points, 11 assists, zero turnovers — the NBA's first 50-10-0 game — as Detroit outlasted Washington in double OT.

stories.title: Warriors' Curry out at least 2 weeks with oblique injury, could miss a month
stories.take: Curry is out at least two weeks with an oblique tear, and Golden State is bracing for closer to a month.

stories.title: Rockets' Smart suspended 3 games for punch
stories.take: Settled: Marcus Smart gets three games without pay for punching Charles Bassey — the suspension landed Thursday.

stories.title: Bulls rookie Wilson has successful surgery on fractured hand
stories.take: Bulls rookie Caleb Wilson had surgery on his fractured hand and is out 4-6 weeks — his Rookie of the Year push likely ends here.

stories.title: Harden brushes off early-season criticism as throwback 32-point effort leads Cavs
stories.take: Harden shook off a slow start with a season-high 32 as Cleveland beat the Knicks 115-107; Brunson taking zero free throws drew Mike Brown's ire.

stories.title: Reaves exits with heel injury as banged-up Lakers win 7th straight
stories.take: The Lakers won their seventh straight, but Austin Reaves exited with a heel injury — X-rays negative, further evaluation ahead.

stories.title: Cubs superstar Pete Crow-Armstrong wins National League MVP unanimously, beating Shohei Ohtani
stories.take: Pete Crow-Armstrong is the unanimous NL MVP, beating Shohei Ohtani — a dominant third full season for the 24-year-old Cubs star.

stories.title: Astros slugger Yordan Alvarez named unanimous American League MVP after nearly winning 2026 Triple Crown
stories.take: Yordan Alvarez is the unanimous AL MVP after nearly winning the Triple Crown — a full comeback from his injury-riddled 2025.

stories.title: Braves bolster bullpen, reach 3-year, $35 million deal with Phillips
stories.take: Atlanta bolsters its bullpen with Evan Phillips from the Dodgers: three years, $35 million.

stories.title: Former catcher Ausmus lands Astros manager job, 'can't wait to get to work'
stories.take: Houston hires franchise icon Brad Ausmus as manager — the former Astros catcher returns after a stint as Yankees bench coach.

stories.title: Tarik Skubal free agency tracker: Latest on MLB's top free agent
stories.take: All eyes on Tarik Skubal: the two-time Cy Young winner is the winter's top free agent, and his market sets the offseason's pace.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Phillies OF on the trading block, Blue Jays eye ex-Yankee, plus Mets, Mariners, Braves, Rays, more
stories.take: Hot stove, Nov. 12: Phillies outfielder on the block, Blue Jays eye a former Yankee, and the Mets, Mariners, Braves and Rays all feature.

stories.title: Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader
stories.take: Chris Van Hollen will challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader, saying midterm voters demanded change from the status quo.

stories.title: New York building collapse kills 8, including 2 children
stories.take: Brooklyn collapse, final toll: eight dead, including two children, and officials say rescue operations have ended with no more victims inside.

stories.title: Police identify suspect and victim in Washington DC gym shooting that also injured four
stories.take: Police identified the Logan Circle gym shooting suspect and victim; four were injured and the gunman died of a self-inflicted wound.

stories.title: How Scott Colom won his longshot bid to flip Mississippi's Senate seat
stories.take: How Scott Colom pulled the longshot: a Democrat flipping Mississippi's Senate seat, the state's first Black senator since Reconstruction.

stories.title: Cindy Holscher wins in Kansas, holding governor's office for Democrats
stories.take: Cindy Holscher holds Kansas's governor's office for Democrats, beating a Trump-endorsed Republican in a state the GOP swept elsewhere.

stories.title: Senators probe RFK Jr.'s reason for Samoa trip after letter refuting his testimony published
stories.take: Two senators are investigating whether RFK Jr. misled Congress about his 2019 Samoa trip after a published letter contradicted his testimony.

stories.title: Putin takes hard line in US talks as Ukraine says Starlink disrupted again
stories.take: Putin takes a hard line in US talks, warning Russia would target any foreign troops in Ukraine and refusing to soften territorial demands.

stories.title: Newsom names Nancy Pelosi, Barry Bonds, Robin Williams to California Hall of Fame
stories.take: Newsom names Nancy Pelosi, Barry Bonds and Robin Williams among 18 new California Hall of Fame honorees.

stories.title: Notorious Graffiti Towers wiped clean in downtown Los Angeles
stories.take: Downtown LA's Graffiti Towers are wiped clean — the Oceanwide Plaza eyesore, painted up to 54 stories, is gone before the 2028 spotlight.

stories.title: Bass says her election defeat was part of a national wave, with voters demanding change
stories.take: Karen Bass calls her defeat part of a national change wave: voters 'just want everything new' every five or six years.

stories.title: Troubled LAX people mover drops further into junk bond status as key deadline nears
stories.take: The troubled LAX people mover sinks deeper into junk as Fitch downgrades it again with a key deadline approaching.

stories.title: These part-time professors make big money teaching dozens of classes online. Are their students learning?
stories.take: Some part-time community college professors teach dozens of online classes across campuses and clear $400K — with no cap on course loads, students may be shortchanged.

stories.title: Bring out your umbrellas. Cooling temperatures and scattered showers start Thursday night
stories.take: Umbrellas out: SoCal cools about 10 degrees with scattered showers starting Thursday night into the weekend.

stories.title: CalFresh fraud, El Niño costal flooding concerns, Center for disaster prep — Evening Edition
stories.take: Eight LA County residents charged with taking $177K+ in CalFresh/CalWORKs benefits by lying about income; DA's office has filed 340 such fraud cases this year, $4M+ in losses • El Niño marine heat wave has ocean temps Sonoma-to-Ensenada 10° above average — unprecedented — with king tides later this month a half-foot to a foot higher, raising coastal flood risk • Caltech's new Center for Disaster Resilience, led by Lucy Jones, will get credible quake/fire/flood info to the public in a disaster • Space Shuttle Endeavour's new home, the 200,000-sq-ft Samuel Oschin Air and Space Center, opens Friday — free admission

stories.title: Jensen Huang Is Out at Nvidia
stories.take: The reporters who broke the story reconstruct the fall: a second affair, with Nvidia healthcare VP Kimberly Powell, forced the board's hand Wednesday night; Huang isn't even quoted in Nvidia's resignation statement • Succession is near-impossible — Huang never groomed one and had ~60 direct reports; interim CEO Colette Kress is a finance hand, and chip CEOs must be world-class computer scientists • Washington's tide turned after the midterms: hearings, chip bills and a DOJ criminal probe into Megaspeed are ahead, while AMD and Broadcom circle • Bottom line from the panel: frontier-lab demand, not the chip drama, decides whether the AI boom survives

stories.title: Nvidia was AI's linchpin. Now what?
stories.take: The answer: nothing structural yet — Nvidia stays at the center of AI compute and of the circular financing web (stakes in OpenAI, xAI, Anthropic; a VC arm funding chip buyers), closing just under $4 trillion with shares off ~5%; what's missing is Huang as the industry's salesman-in-chief • Silicon Valley's vibe 'feels like an earthquake'; even the Denny's booth where Nvidia was hatched is updating its valuation plaque downward • Tariffs keep feeding inflation as suppliers pass costs through, and Bloomberg's new private CPI tracker reads October at ~4.6% year over year, hotter than BLS • JetBlue's first-class bet shows where airline money is: premium cabins in a K-shaped economy

stories.title: Jensen Huang, a Leader of the Global AI Boom, Is Out as Nvidia CEO
stories.take: The board moved after the second affair — one with a suspected Chinese spy, one with an employee — fearing a pattern; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and the search is on • Nvidia fell 14% at the open but closed down only 4.3% at a $4 trillion market cap; analysts question the circular AI financing Huang championed • Tuesday's earnings call is the test: Kress's steering and any change to the big financing deals matter more than the already-done quarter's numbers • Also: home sales hit a 16-year low with mortgages over 7%, and Trump reversed course, saying the US doesn't need an Iran deal

stories.title: How Democrats overperformed in the South
stories.take: The answer: Black voters turned out at near-presidential levels while Republicans stayed home — Scott Colom outpolled Kamala Harris's Mississippi total by ~7,000 and won by 5,000+, while Hyde-Smith drew 120,000 fewer votes than Trump in his top 10 Mississippi counties; six Southern states swung left 22 points on average vs. 15 nationally • Democrats flipped Senate seats in Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina and Texas, powered by anger over the Supreme Court gutting the Voting Rights Act and redistricting that diluted Black voting power • The panel's biggest surprises: North Carolina's collapse (Cooper would have won with zero Election Day votes), Texas, and South Carolina called as polls closed • Open question: six-year terms are locked in, but holding these states in a presidential year is another matter

stories.title: LB Naples Christmas boat parade canceled,  Wet weather in SoCal, Artist Lita Albuquerque work coming to the High Desert— Afternoon Edition
stories.take: Long Beach's Naples Christmas boat parade and light contest are canceled this year — crumbling seawalls plus record El Niño high tides; neighbors call the handling reactive, though decorated houses will still draw crowds • SoCal cools down: mid-60s to low 70s this weekend, light rain, and a possible mountain snow dusting Monday with snow levels near 5,000 feet • Lita Albuquerque's The Interval Between Things — a 274-foot line of blue pigment in the desert — opens Saturday at High Desert Test Sites near Joshua Tree
